scope: Complete actual-issue title/date/state index; selected issue bodies and specific current source paths reviewed deeply. This is not 2327 reproduced bugs, not every comment, not a full PR diff review, not live provider validation. Comment endpoints for six selected issues were later fetched completely (two comments total); all other discussion remains unreviewed.

selectedIssues.title: Gemini-native /v1beta requests to Antigravity models lose the client's functionDeclarations (tools never reach the model)
selectedIssues.reason: Real translateRequest GEMINI→ANTIGRAVITY plus AntigravityExecutor.transformRequest retains functionDeclarations and normalizes schema for both stream values. Native key aliases covered by gemini-native-chat-contract.test.js. This does not prove live model entitlement/behavior.
selectedIssues.commentReview: No comments; no further pipeline reproducer or linked fix supplied.

selectedIssues.title: Kiro [400]: {"message":"profileArn is required for this request.","reason":null}
selectedIssues.reason: Report contains only profileArn required error, without auth method, endpoint or credential shape. Existing import/refresh resolves account-specific profiles; api_key uses Amazon Q with TokenType API_KEY; IDC/external IdP intentionally avoid another account shared ARN. Do not invent a profile ARN.
selectedIssues.commentReview: One confirmation comment: Same error here. No auth method, endpoint, credential shape, reproducer or linked fix supplied.

selectedIssues.title: Zed Claude Sonnet 5.5 returns invalid JSON Schema error when routed through Antigravity MITM
selectedIssues.reason: Report omits the offending schema. Representative real Antigravity→OpenAI→Claude chain already lowercases types, converts string minItems/maxItems to integers, and nullable to union. Zed uses the shared Claude translator. No evidence supports blanket dropping tools/keywords or switching schema drafts for all inputs.
selectedIssues.commentReview: No comments; no offending tool schema supplied.

selectedIssues.title: The usage statistics for Codebuddy (intl and CN) are invalid
selectedIssues.reason: Body contains two screenshot URLs only; no request/response or expected usage contract. Screenshots were not fetched; no speculative quota/auth change.

selectedIssues.title: [Bug] OpenCode Free via proxy pool bypasses wreq-js TLS impersonation (native fetch) — still 429
selectedIssues.reason: OpenCode request reports wreq-js TLS impersonation/proxy split. Existing Kitsune audit explicitly deferred unverified native TLS adapters. Do not import a new spoofing/native artifact based on issue claims; requires supported publisher/transport evidence and verification.

selectedIssues.title: [Bug / Feature Request] Incompatibility with latest VS Code Copilot Chat Update in Agent Mode (Tool Calling / Context Issue)
selectedIssues.reason: Report provides user configuration and high-level hang, without actual new request/tool schema. Existing format-specific tool/SSE tests address known invariants; do not certify every newest Copilot agent request.

selectedIssues.title: fix(codebuddy-intl): HTTP 400 Code 11128 "request illegal" due to failed channel verification
selectedIssues.reason: New report duplicates CodeBuddy channel header family. Current DefaultExecutor hooks and registry entries add required request/conversation ID header family; local tests exist. Live account acceptance not asserted.

selectedIssues.title: CodeBuddy Intl: HTTP 400 code 11128 — channel verification requires X-Conversation-* header family since 2026-10-15
selectedIssues.reason: Required conversation/request/message ID family already included by CodeBuddy hooks. Alternative issue proposal for session derivation is not an authoritative protocol change.

selectedIssues.title: Antigravity: switching Claude <-> Gemini mid-conversation fails with 400 "Corrupted thought signature" (signature cache is not model-aware)
selectedIssues.reason: Issue names process-global thoughtSignatureStore keyed by call ID. That module is absent in this fork, whose AGENTS contract requires request-local recovery. Preserve current request-local provenance; do not install global fallback cache or dummy signatures.

selectedIssues.title: ByteString header error persists across all providers after certain usage; fixed by rotating the 9Router API key
selectedIssues.reason: Persistent ByteString failure report lacks offending header/key metadata. Do not rotate credentials automatically or claim header source; current secret/header handling deserves targeted capture without values.

selectedIssues.title: [Feature Request] Automatic Proxy Rotation (Proxy Pool) for Provider Connections
selectedIssues.reason: Proxy rotation feature request includes cycling after rate limits/blocks. Existing chosen-pool consistency fix is distinct: test and runtime must share chosen egress, without silently rotating policies or retrying blocked accounts.

selectedIssues.title: Combo marks non-streaming JSON responses as empty when the client omits `stream`
selectedIssues.reason: Current clientRequestedStreaming defaults OpenAI omitted stream to false; headroom-chat-core and openai-stream-default tests cover contract. Do not re-import older upstream stream decision.

selectedIssues.title: Custom openai-compatible providers get limits from the pattern table, not the synced catalog — hyphenated ids (e.g. kenari/glm-5-3-flash) resolve to 200K/128K instead of 1M/131072
selectedIssues.reason: collectEntries still snapshots registry models only, so automatic sync does not establish limits for arbitrary custom node identities. However provider/product identity cannot be inferred from model punctuation/name alone; require explicit authoritative product binding or operator caps, with provider-scoped limits/negative evidence. Avoid copying blanket 1M limits or globally replacing hyphens.
selectedIssues.commentReview: No comments; no additional product-binding or implementation evidence supplied.

selectedIssues.title: [Security & UX] "Probe-on-Save" Provider Key Validation & Auto-Exclusion of Inactive/Broken Providers from Combo Builder
selectedIssues.reason: Related to current local fix: pre-save validation must bind to exact credential/destination/proxy snapshot, and must not reuse a stale badge. Not a wholesale import of feature proposal or new claim of sufficient balance/inference from models endpoint. A freshly read maintainer comment explicitly classifies the issue as a batch proposal without a narrow testable PR; current local defects were independently reproduced, not inherited as established facts from that proposal.
selectedIssues.commentReview: One maintainer comment closes the proposal as part of a batch without a narrow testable PR; suggests a future single concrete repro/small PR. This is proposal context, not proof of a reproduced defect or adopted fix.

selectedIssues.title: [Bug] Connection testStatus goes stale: dashboard shows Valid/active while DB keeps old 403 and server uses cached credentials until restart
selectedIssues.reason: Historical issue concerns persisted OAuth status/cache invalidation after re-login, not exactly current form race. Current form snapshot fix is related consistency work; retain existing separate DB cache invalidation guarantees.

selectedIssues.title: fix(xiaomi-tokenplan): Test Connection route hardcodes SGP endpoint and ignores selected region (false 'Failed' for AMS/CN keys)
selectedIssues.reason: Issue concerns Xiaomi region mismatch on saved test route. Current add/edit Check destination/proxy alignment is related but not a claim that every provider test branch was newly rewritten. Do not adopt issue suggestion to treat every non401 response as valid.
selectedIssues.commentReview: No comments; issue body remains the available region-specific test-route reproduction.

selectedIssues.title: [BUG] Anthropic translator overrides existing thinking block signatures, causing 400 "Invalid signature in thinking block"
selectedIssues.reason: Preserving authentic opaque thinking signatures is already established. Current local malformed-base64/type hardening concerns safe structural validation; cannot cryptographically validate or manufacture provider signatures.

selectedIssues.title: API Error 400: Invalid signature in thinking block via proxy
selectedIssues.reason: Report only supplies invalid thinking-signature error through a proxy. Current structural signature validation fix is useful local hardening, not proof this historical account issue is resolved.

selectedIssues.title: Antigravity/Gemini multi-turn tool calls fail: thoughtSignature dropped in translation
selectedIssues.reason: Current engine retains signature provenance through roundtrip and insists on request-local recovery; do not import historical process-wide cache or fabricate signed data.

selectedIssues.title: [Bug] Gemini API 400 Bad Request on Claude tool_use (missing thoughtSignature) and stream DONE sentinel
selectedIssues.reason: Native Gemini response contract already avoids OpenAI DONE sentinel and preserves signatures/media. Default signature proposal is not adopted as security guarantee.

selectedIssues.title: Request-log header masking is disabled: provider OAuth tokens are written to logs/ in clear text
selectedIssues.reason: Current requestLogger has central masking/redaction, unlike issue pass-through implementation; prior audits cover security. No raw token logging is restored.

selectedIssues.title: [BUG] Duplicate anthropic-version header on /v1/messages causes 400 invalid_request_error - Version: 0.5.18
selectedIssues.reason: Previously reviewed duplicate anthropic-version family; current shared identity/wire handling retained. No client release pin changed to API header date.

selectedIssues.title: Bug: Kiro AI OAuth connections frequently failed: Token expired and refresh failed
selectedIssues.reason: Token refresh failure report cannot establish new auth header or account ban. Prior audit observed quota rejection in comments; this capture did not fetch comments. Current refresh cancellation/catalog lifetime protections remain.
